title: Tomorrow's Marble source construction record

sources.title: Chrontraption
used_for: dragging time-travelling elements into timeline slots
self-consistent arrival/departure loop as the win condition

construction: Original self-contained HTML/CSS/SVG contraption with four generated machine nodes, visible routing rules, repeated marble identities, an editable timeline, animated event traces, and an independently replayed arrival/departure ledger. It is not a copy, wrapper, or asset import from the cited game.
license_note: The cited survey record supplied mechanic grounding only. Tomorrow's Marble presentation, generated worlds, transition rules, grading, verifier, and browser code are repository-authored.
source_limitations: The source describes the interaction family and consistency objective, not this benchmark's machine graph, piece mapping, timeline, art, difficulty profiles, or event schema.
generated_media: No generated raster media; all visuals are original HTML/CSS/SVG geometry.
